verdict.rationale: The evidence shows extensive Gemini API docs, a quickstart and a WebhookService REST reference. Nothing documents an interactive API reference with in-browser runnable examples (a try-it explorer). The probe also found no public OpenAPI or Swagger spec. Static docs and quickstart code samples are adjacent material and do not count as an interactive, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
